**🍖 Insane Eating**

Eat any food item in just 0.1 seconds! A lightweight,singleplayer Fabric mod that reduces eating time from 1.6 seconds to instant.

**✨ Features**

⚡ Instant Eating – All food items now take only 2 ticks (0.1 seconds) to consume
🍎 Universal Compatibility – Works with every food item (vanilla + modded)
🖥️ Client-Side Only – No server installation needed
🔧 Lightweight – Minimal performance impact, just one simple tweak
📦 Multi-Version Support – Compatible with Minecraft 1.21 to 1.21.10

work only singleplayer world

**🔧 Requirements**

• Minecraft 1.21 to 1.21.10
• Fabric API
